@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Professor Chen cares a lot about student a______e. If you miss more than two classes, you will fail his course.
= attendance
~詞義 attendance（n.）出席
~原文 Professor Chen cares a lot about student attendance. If you miss more than two classes, you will fail his course.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: I enjoy watching d______ries more than dramatic films because I can learn more about the real world.
= documentaries
~詞義 documentary（n.）紀錄片
~原文 I enjoy watching documentaries more than dramatic films because I can learn more about the real world.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: New regulations placed a c______t on the company's budget, which forced the managers to reduce unnecessary expenses.
= constraint
~詞義 constraint（n.）限制;約束
~原文 New regulations placed a constraint on the company's budget, which forced the managers to reduce unnecessary expenses.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Britney likes to watch a few e______es of a comedy show while she has dinner. It doesn't take up much time, but it makes her feel relaxed.
= episodes
~詞義 episode（n.）集(節目)
~原文 Britney likes to watch a few episodes of a comedy show while she has dinner. It doesn't take up much time, but it makes her feel relaxed.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The salesperson r______red the customer that the product was of high quality and that there was nothing to worry about.
= reassured
~詞義 reassure（v.）使安心
~原文 The salesperson reassured the customer that the product was of high quality and that there was nothing to worry about.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The robbers have taken the bank clerks as ______, and they demand that the police not enter the building.
A: contractors
B: equations
C: hostages
D: observers
= C
~詞義 hostage（n.）人質
~原文 The robbers have taken the bank clerks as hostages, and they demand that the police not enter the building.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The old house at the end of the street looks dark and ______. It has been abandoned for quite some time.
A: bronze
B: continental
C: gloomy
D: strategic
= C
~詞義 gloomy（adj.）灰暗的
~原文 The old house at the end of the street looks dark and gloomy. It has been abandoned for quite some time.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Do not make ______ about people based on their appearance; you may very well be wrong.
A: assumptions
B: consultations
C: legacies
D: rebellions
= A
~詞義 assumption（n.）臆測
~原文 Do not make assumptions about people based on their appearance; you may very well be wrong.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ athlete inspired generations of young players who admired his skill, dedication, and exceptional sportsmanship.
A: legendary
B: rebellious
C: worthwhile
D: genetic
= A
~詞義 legendary（adj.）傳奇的
~原文 The legendary athlete inspired generations of young players who admired his skill, dedication, and exceptional sportsmanship.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The chef added various ______ into the soup, and it smelled wonderful.
A: domes
B: herbs
C: stocks
D: yachts
= B
~詞義 herb（n.）藥草
~原文 The chef added various herbs into the soup, and it smelled wonderful.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: athletics
B: operational
C: recite
D: stinks
E: straightens
F: worthwhile

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Robert hasn't cleaned his room in weeks, and it ______ of trash and rotten food.
= D
~詞義 stink（v.）發惡臭
~原文 Robert hasn't cleaned his room in weeks, and it stinks of trash and rotten food.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mindy has a great memory; she can ______ hundreds of poems perfectly.
= C
~詞義 recite（v.）背誦
~原文 Mindy has a great memory; she can recite hundreds of poems perfectly.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Sam always ______ his tie in the elevator so he arrives at the office looking sharp and ready.
= E
~詞義 straighten（v.）使變直
~原文 Sam always straightens his tie in the elevator so he arrives at the office looking sharp and ready.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The school is encouraging girls to attend ______ classes. Sport is not just for boys.
= A
~詞義 athletics（n.）體育活動
~原文 The school is encouraging girls to attend athletics classes. Sport is not just for boys.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Though Roger didn't pass the bar exam, he considers the time and effort he spent on it ______.
= F
~詞義 worthwhile（adj.）值得的
~原文 Though Roger didn't pass the bar exam, he considers the time and effort he spent on it worthwhile.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: astonishing
B: perspective
C: opted
D: herbal
E: strand
F: treaty

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: When Ellen feels stressed, she starts twisting a(n) ______ of hair in her fingers.
= E
~詞義 strand（n.）縷
~原文 When Ellen feels stressed, she starts twisting a(n) strand of hair in her fingers.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The magician's performance included ______ tricks that left the entire audience speechless.
= A
~詞義 astonishing（adj.）驚人的
~原文 The magician's performance included astonishing tricks that left the entire audience speechless.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Traveling abroad put Frank's personal struggles in ______, making him appreciate opportunities he previously took for granted.
= B
~詞義 perspective（n.）以客觀、整體的角度(in perspective)
~原文 Traveling abroad put Frank's personal struggles in perspective, making him appreciate opportunities he previously took for granted.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: In the end, Taylor ______ to buy a smaller car because he thought it would be easier to park.
= C
~詞義 opt（v.）選擇
~原文 In the end, Taylor opted to buy a smaller car because he thought it would be easier to park.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The two neighboring countries finally signed a peace ______, which ended decades of conflict and hostility.
= F
~詞義 treaty（n.）條約
~原文 The two neighboring countries finally signed a peace treaty, which ended decades of conflict and hostility.
